data.text:
JUST IN: Ahead of the announced nationwide transport strike of PISTON and Manibela from Sept. 17-19, the UP Manila Office of the Vice Chancellor for Academic Affairs (OVCAA) has urged the faculty to provide leniency for students who might encounter difficulties in attending on-site classes and activities.  

The faculty is encouraged to adopt flexible and accessible learning delivery methods to accommodate thousands of UP Manila students commuting across Metro Manila.
